title: Correct positional-inversion matching and seek a completion-feasible value perturbation
frozenQuestion: Can a support-qualified direct value-position reassignment be matched exactly on true positional inversion count and retain prespecified completion comparability in all six balanced repeated/unique policy-pair conditions, including every Selection condition, under unchanged native budgets and scheduler semantics?

scope.claimBoundary: Any qualifying contrast is specific to the frozen direct field-reassignment intervention. It is not a natural indirect effect, pure mediator intervention, or proof that value arrangement is the sole cause of aggregation.

sourcePopulation.selection: Exclude S07 calibration ordinals congruent to 1 mod 10 and S07/S11 holdout ordinals congruent to 5 mod 10. Within each condition, SHA-256 rank the remaining 200 ordinals with the frozen S11R split address; allocate the first 25 to calibration, the next 25 to holdout, and the remaining 150 to reserve.

checkpoint.definition: Earliest validated S06 aggregation maximum at or below 75% accepted-swap progress, carried forward from S11.
checkpoint.targetAcceptedSwaps: floor(progress * validated native final accepted swaps)

matcher.metric: Count pairs i<j with value[i]>value[j]; equal values do not contribute.
matcher.primaryTarget: Both selected assignments must have exactly the same true positional inversion count; intended distance is zero.
matcher.secondaryTarget: Minimize absolute difference in total absolute value change among distinct assignments at the exact inversion target.
matcher.tertiaryTarget: Maximize positional Hamming distance between assignments, then break ties by assignment hashes.
matcher.productionAssertion: Every selected pair must attain true inversion-distance zero, exact requested changed-position count, a preserved global value multiset, no unchanged value on a selected position, and at least 16 distinct assignments in the selected exact target bin.
matcher.smallCaseValidation: Exhaustively enumerate small unique and repeated-value arrangements and all candidate pairs used by the small-case fixtures; compare inversion counts and the matcher objective with independent brute force.

calibration.outcomeBlindRestriction: Calibration reads assignment diagnostics and terminal/completion accounting only. Aggregation and Sortedness trajectories are neither retained nor analyzed.
calibration.nativeReference: The exactly replayed source is the no-switch/sham reference and must be complete in all selected scenarios.
calibration.selectionRule: Promote the last (strongest) candidate in the frozen ladder that passes every gate. If none passes, classify the intervention as completion-infeasible and do not execute holdout continuations.

holdout.executionRule: Run only the single promoted calibration candidate.
holdout.completionGate: Repeat every calibration completion and validation threshold on the sealed holdout before estimating effects.
estimandsIfGatePasses: paired value_primary minus no_switch composition-corrected adjacency curve and signed area
paired value_matched minus no_switch composition-corrected adjacency curve and signed area
paired reference-Sortedness curves as explicit task-progress diagnostics
holdout.ifGateFails: Document infeasibility and do not report a causal or component-effect estimate.

exact: occupancy and identity order at intervention
policy, direction, fault, and analysis-label fields
activation count, stream counters, ledger, seed, scheduler, runtime key, and max_activations
Selection cursor map attached to the same identities
changedByDesign: value fields for exactly the requested identities
task progress and possibly policy-value association
preservation.eventBudget: Never increased, weakened, restarted, or conditionally extended.
preservation.schedulerCoupling: Counter-addressed actor and policy-side streams remain identical because executable policies, seed, runtime key, and activation index are preserved.

outcomeClassification.supportive: Calibration and holdout gates pass and yield a validated intervention-specific estimate.
outcomeClassification.constrainingContradictory: No calibration candidate passes, or the promoted candidate fails holdout completion/validation.
outcomeClassification.null: A validated feasible estimate is indistinguishable from zero with adequate precision.
